Hey! I'm Matthias 👋
Head of Creation at a mobile gaming studio — we've crossed 1 billion downloads, small team, fully independent. I've been deep in AI tooling for a while now, mostly on the creative production side: Claude for writing and agents, Figma Weave for image/video pipelines, custom MCP servers for connecting things that don't naturally talk to each other.
